warmup.description: Prime upper body with emphasis on shoulder stability, scapular control, and unilateral activation.
movements: Resistance band external rotations x 12 each side
Single-arm dumbbell rows (light) x 10 each side
Shoulder CARs (controlled rotations) x 5 each side

main_exercises.name: Single-Arm Dumbbell Bench Press
main_exercises.load_guidance: Choose a challenging weight that leaves 1-2 reps in reserve while maintaining control
main_exercises.form_cue: Keep hips stable and avoid rotating as you press

main_exercises.name: Chest-Supported Dumbbell Row
main_exercises.load_guidance: Heavy load at 8/10 effort with strict control at the top
main_exercises.form_cue: Pause briefly at the top and squeeze shoulder blades together

main_exercises.name: Arnold Press
main_exercises.load_guidance: Moderate-heavy load that challenges the last reps without losing range of motion
main_exercises.form_cue: Rotate smoothly through the movement and avoid rushing the press

main_exercises.name: Neutral Grip Lat Pulldown
main_exercises.load_guidance: Select a load where the final reps are challenging but controlled
main_exercises.form_cue: Pull elbows down toward your sides, not back

main_exercises.name: Lateral Raise Mechanical Drop Set
main_exercises.load_guidance: Start with a weight you can control for 10-12 reps, then reduce range for partials without dropping weight
main_exercises.form_cue: Lead with elbows and keep tension through the full range

main_exercises.name: Superset: Hammer Curl + Overhead Dumbbell Triceps Extension
main_exercises.load_guidance: Moderate load that allows smooth, controlled reps without swinging
main_exercises.form_cue: Keep elbows stable and avoid compensating through the shoulders

cooldown.description: Reduce upper body tension and improve mobility after unilateral and high-intensity work.
movements: Thread the needle stretch x 30s each side
Overhead triceps stretch x 30s each side
Doorway chest stretch x 30s each side

phase_notes.menstrual: Unilateral work in this session can help you stay engaged without needing maximal loads—reduce intensity if needed and focus on control and balance. Take longer rest if fatigue shows up quickly.
phase_notes.follicular: Great phase to push unilateral strength and coordination—challenge yourself with heavier dumbbells and focus on symmetry between sides. You may notice improved control and energy.
phase_notes.ovulatory: You can perform at your peak here—push intensity on single-arm presses and rows while maintaining strong core stability. Be mindful of joint alignment, especially in shoulders.
phase_notes.early_luteal: Maintain strong effort but avoid pushing every set to near failure—focus on clean reps and controlled tempo, especially in unilateral movements where fatigue can show quickly.
phase_notes.late_luteal: This session’s complexity may feel more demanding—consider reducing drop sets or lowering load slightly. Prioritize stability and clean execution over intensity.
